units.source_text: 弘徽殿太后的哥哥藤大纳言的儿子头弁，自从祖父右大臣专权以来，变成了一个青年红人，目空一切。

en.t: To no Ben, the son of Fuji Dainagon, who was the brother of the Empress Dowager Kokiden, had become a rising young favorite ever since his grandfather, the Minister of the Right, came to dominate affairs, and he looked down on everyone.

units.source_text: 此时这头弁正前往探望其妹丽景殿女御，恰巧源氏大将的前驱人低声喝着，从后面赶上来。

en.t: At that moment To no Ben was on his way to visit his younger sister, the Reikeiden consort, when Genji the general's outriders happened to come up from behind, calling out in low voices.

units.source_text: 头弁的车子暂时停住，头弁在车中从容不迫地朗诵道：“白虹贯日，太子畏之！”

en.t: To no Ben's carriage stopped for a moment, and from inside it he calmly recited, "A white rainbow pierces the sun, and the crown prince fears it!"

units.source_text: 意思是讥讽源氏将不利于朱雀帝。

en.t: He meant it as a taunt, implying that Genji would bring harm to Emperor Suzaku.

units.source_text: 源氏大将听了实在难堪，然而不便和他计较。

en.t: Genji the general was deeply embarrassed when he heard it, but it would not do to quarrel with him.

units.source_text: 因为弘徽殿太后痛恨源氏大将，对他态度十分冷酷，太后的亲信便常常嘲弄源氏大将。

en.t: Because the Empress Dowager Kokiden hated Genji the general and treated him with great coldness, those close to her often mocked him.

units.source_text: 源氏大将不胜其烦，但也只得装作不听见，默默地走过了。

en.t: Genji the general found it almost unbearable, but he could only pretend not to hear and pass by in silence.
